facts.fact: Neela counts the ache from a moon after the last night she turns; nobody has tested the count on purpose.
The pass-village watcher walks the ridge track, so Neela and Devan choose the wood road by the lower ford, half a day longer.
Ittan's tally book records four slash payments to the Resin House and a hook (delivery); a folded-wing sunbird is inked beside three lines and Neela cannot read it.
Neela takes the east stair and avoids the west stair without stating a reason.
Ittan asks only after his wife's willow-bark medicine and glances repeatedly at the dark corner of the guardroom; Neela judges he fears someone other than Devan.
Devan will not promise to let Neela choose in a life-or-death moment: 'I won't promise what I can't swear I'd keep.'
